September, 2020 IN THE HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH :: AMARA THURSDAY, THE THIRD DAY OF SEPTEMBER TWO THOUSAND AND TWENTY : PRESENT:
THE HONOURABLE SMT JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI CRIMINAL PETITION NO: 3421 OF 2020 Between:

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH :: AMARA THURSDAY
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Sri Penumalla Suresh, S/o Narasimha Murthy, Aged 33 yrs, R/o D.No.33-20-113,
Chaluva Thota, Allipuram Visakhapatnam Petitioner/Accused-2 AND The State of Andhra Pradesh, Through the S.H.O., of Ill Town P.S., Visakhapatnam Rep., by its Public Prosecutor High Court at Amaravathi.

Respondent/Complainant Petition under Section 437 & 439 of Cr.P.C, praying that in the circumstances stated in the memorandum of grounds of Criminal Petition, the High Court may be pleased to enlarge the petitioner/Accused no.2 on Regular Bail in Crime No.588/2020 dated 02.07.2020, of II] Town P.S., Visakhapatnam The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the grounds filed in support thereof and upon hearing the arguments of SRI R Siva Sai Swarup Advocate for the Petitioner, and of Public Prosecutor for the Respondent, the Court made the following.
ORDER:
THE HON'BLE SMT. JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI CRIMINAL PETITION NO.3421 of 2020 ORDER:-
This petition is filed under Sections 437 and 439 of Code of the Criminal Procedure,
1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') seeking regular bail to the petitioner/A-2 in connection with Crime No.588 of 2020 of III Town Police Station, Visakhapatnam District for the offences punishable under Sections 270, 273, 328 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860(for short IPC', Section 20(b) r/w 8(c) of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 (for short 'NDPS Act' and Sections 59(i) and 59(ii) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'FSS Act'.
2. Heard Sri Siva Sai Swarup, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
Sri Penumalla Suresh vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 3 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63628023/
1 3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The case of prosecution is that the Inspector of Police, II] Town Police Station, Visakhapatnam City on 02.07.2020 found one person going on TVS Motor cycle on seeing the police, he tried to escape.

entities.text: II] Town Police Station, Visakhapatnam City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Then the police caught hold of the said person and asked about the details and confessed by A-3 the police searched and found tobacco products like Gutkha, Khainee etc., in the name of brand Gokul Deluxe tobacco, Meeraj etc., and also seized 4 KGs of Ganja in two packets.

Basing on that,
the crime was registered.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in respect of other crimes under IPC, COTP Act and FSS Act, this Court has already quashed the proceedings in FIR No.588 of 2020 vide order dated 22.07.2020 in Crl.P.No.2767 of 2020.

Learned counsel further submits that as far as the offence punishable under NDPS Act is concerned, the contraband seized from the accused is 4 KGs which is not a commercial quantity, as such prays for grant of bail to the petitioner.
5. The learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application.

6. However, taking into consideration the fact that the contraband seized from the accused is 4 KGs which is not a commercial quantity, this Court feels that this is a fit case for grant of regular bail to the petitioner/A-2.
7.
Accordingly, this Criminal Petition is allowed.

The petitioner/ A-2 shall be enlarged on bail on execution of self bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand only) with two sureties for a like sum each to the satisfaction of the IV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Visakhapatnam.

entities.text: IV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Visakhapatnam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Consequently, miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
SD/-G.SRINIVAS REDDY ASSISTANT REGISTRAR.

The IV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Visakhapatnam .
